'''Shadow Hounds''' are found in the [[Shadow Dungeon]]. They are encountered during the [[Desert Treasure]] quest, and they can be found throughout the [[Chaos Tunnels]].

They tend to interfere when a player is using the poison-technique on Damis. After Desert Treasure, they are difficult to kill in the Shadow Dungeon unless a player is willing to fend off level 84 [[Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon)|giant skeletons]]; they respawn fast and are present throughout the dungeon. The easiest place to kill Shadow Hounds is in the small round chamber leading off to the north-west of Damis's chamber. It contains a level 7 [[giant rat]] and one hound, and it provides a reasonably safe place away from the skeletons.
